description:
Refresh social performance data

Fetch fresh platform metrics for your published content. Can target one post or video; otherwise refreshes a bounded recent batch (100 posts, 50 videos). May stop early to stay within the request time budget; skipped counts unrefreshed platform metrics. Refresh those posts individually after the cooldown. Limited to one refresh per user every five minutes across instances. Returns real successes and failures; missing metrics are not zero performance.
name: refreshAnalytics
